policy: Only use data whose licence and terms permit this use. Record the source, licence, retrieval date and transformations. Never scrape private accounts or ignore an access restriction.

sources.name: FineWeb-Edu
sources.size: ~1.3T tokens / ~5.8 TB; use a small shard first
sources.notes: Educational web text. Attribute the dataset and comply with Common Crawl's terms; original pages keep their own rights.

sources.name: Wikipedia database dumps
sources.size: Choose a language and a single dump, not the whole site
sources.notes: Attribute Wikipedia and share alike. Dumps are snapshots; they are not a live fact source.

sources.name: OpenStax textbooks
sources.notes: Peer-reviewed open textbooks. Preserve attribution and do not imply endorsement by the publisher.

sources.name: Project Gutenberg
sources.license: Public domain in the US (check the book's country)
sources.notes: The Gutenberg trademark and access rules still apply. Do not bulk-scrape the site.

sources.name: OpenAssistant Conversations (OASST1)
sources.notes: Human-written and human-ranked conversation trees. Filter for quality and remove personal data before use.

sources.name: Databricks Dolly 15k
sources.notes: Human-written instruction data. Attribute and share alike. Review examples for factual errors.

sources.name: HelpSteer2
sources.notes: Preference/helpfulness data. It teaches style and ranking, not domain truth; keep factual sources separate.

sources.name: GSM8K
sources.notes: Grade-school word problems with worked solutions. Hold out the test split; never train on evaluation cases.

sources.name: OpenMathInstruct-2
sources.notes: Synthetic math instruction data. Verify the current dataset card and filter incorrect or duplicated solutions.

sources.name: Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard data
sources.notes: Use for held-out tool-call evaluation. Do not copy evaluation prompts into training.

sources.name: The Stack v2
sources.license: The Stack v2 Terms of Use (gated; per-repository licences apply)
sources.notes: Filter by permissive repository licences, honour opt-outs, and exclude secrets or generated code. Do not assume all code is reusable.

sources.name: Wikivoyage
sources.notes: Useful for travel and guest-service language. It is not a booking system or a source of live prices.

sources.name: World Bank Open Data
sources.notes: Cite the indicator and year. Economic data is historical; do not present it as current advice.

sources.name: SEC EDGAR
sources.license: US government public records (SEC access terms apply)
sources.notes: Set a descriptive User-Agent and respect rate limits. Filings are primary sources, not investment advice.

sources.name: OpenAlex
sources.notes: Metadata and citation graph. Article full text may have a different licence; follow the linked work.

sources.name: Common Crawl
sources.notes: Read and accept the terms first. Prefer a curated derivative such as FineWeb-Edu rather than crawling the web yourself.

sources.name: Stack Exchange data dump
sources.license: CC BY-SA, but the current dump has an LLM-training restriction
sources.notes: Excluded: the current distribution requires accepting terms that prohibit training an LLM. Do not bypass that restriction.

sources.name: Enron email corpus
sources.notes: Excluded: private communications and personal data. Use owned or synthetic email examples instead.
